newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to announce '97 energy price hike on Nov 2.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to announce '97 energy price hike on Nov 2.

text.p: The Hungarian government will decide on the rate of gas and electricity price increases due on January 1, 1997, at its meeting on November 21, a government official said on Thursday.
"We will announce the rates next Thursday," government spokesman Elemer Kiss told reporters.

Privatisation Minister Judit Csiha, Minister of Industry and Trade Szabolcs Fazakas and Imre Karl, government commissioner in charge of the energy price rise, will meet western investors of the energy sector for a last consultation on Wednesday before the government's decision, Kiss said.
He did not disclose details of the negotiations but a government official told the press in the past few weeks the energy price rise is likely to be between 20 to 25 percent.
Kiss said Karl will inform the government about the costs of energy companies which he proposes for the government to acknowledge as a basis for the energy price rise.
The government will decide on Karl's proposal about the rates of energy price hikes and Fazakas would announce the rates following the cabinet decision, Kiss said.

Hungary's government earlier postoponed to January 1, 1997 an energy price rise increase expected for October 1, which was supposed to give energy producer and supplier comapnies an eight percent return on equity.
